fee_notes: Royalties are tiered by bakery type: Non-Street-Front Bakery = 7% of Adjusted Gross Revenue; Non-Street-Front Bakery in Walmart = 6% of Adjusted Gross Revenue; Street-Front Bakery = 5% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. Advertising Fund Contributions are also tiered: Non-Street-Front Bakery = 1% of Adjusted Gross Revenue; Non-Street-Front Bakery in Walmart = 2% of Adjusted Gross Revenue; Street-Front Bakery = 3% of Adjusted Gross Revenue (may be increased up to 3%, 4%, and 5% respectively with 30 days notice). No single royalty_pct or marketing_fee_pct can be set due to tiered structure. Technology Fee is currently $29.50 weekly (approx. $127.85/month), but may increase up to approximately $300/month. Additional fees include: Secret Shopper $75/shop; Repeat Inspection $500; Bi-Annual Convention $1,500+; Ongoing Training cost+20%; Audit expenses if underpayment >3%; Relocation $7,500; Renewal Fee 50% of then-current initial fee (Bakery 10-yr term, Concession Truck/Trailer 5-yr term), currently $3,750 for Concession Truck/Trailer; Transfer Fee $40,000 (first 12 months) or $20,000 (thereafter) for Bakery, $3,750 for Concession Truck/Trailer; Remote Mobile Unit Transfer Fee = 1/2 of current Remote Mobile Unit Fee; Interest on Late Payments = lower of 18%/yr or max allowed by law; Base Rent = monthly per sublease; Sublease Fee = $200/month initial; Late Fee for Financial Statements = $100/week/store; Lease Review Fee = $3,500-$7,000; Site Evaluation Fee = $750 per additional trip; Supplier Fee up to $500; Private Offering Fee $5,000; Document Administration Fee $500; Gift Card Redemption Fee = currently 11% of redemption amount; Lease Guarantee Fee = 10% of total guaranteed up to $10,000; Sublease Late Charge = 5% of late/unpaid amount; NSF Fee = $50/returned EFT.

Royalties For a Non-Street-Front Bakery, 7% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. For a Non-Street-Front Bakery located within a Walmart location, the Royalty Fee may be reduced to 6% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. For a Street-Front Bakery, 5% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. By Wednesday of each week, or any other day designated by us in the Manual. See note 2.
Advertising Fund Contributions For a Non-Street-Front Bakery, 1% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. For a Non-Street-Front Bakery located within a Walmart location, 2% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. For a Street-Front Bakery, 3% of Adjusted Gross Revenue. By Wednesday of each week, or any other day designated by us in the Manual. See note 2. We may increase this amount upon 30 days' prior written notice to you, but to not more than the following percentages of Adjusted Gross Revenue: 3% for a Non-Street-Front Bakery, 4% for a Non-Street-Front Bakery located within a Walmart, and 5% for a Street-Front Bakery.
